desc.reindexFixOutdated: Use when searches miss recent mails. Reindexes only outdated documents; moderate load.
desc.reindexRebuildAll: Use after an OpenSearch loss or a mapping change. Rebuilds the whole index; heavy load, can take hours.
desc.perUserReindex: The same full reindex, split into one task per user so that a failure stays limited to one account.
desc.populateEmailQueryView: Use after enabling the email query view. Fills it from the existing messages; moderate load.
desc.reindexContacts: Fills the recipient autocompletion of every user from the mails they sent.
desc.fixMailboxInconsistencies: Use when mailboxes are missing, duplicated or cannot be opened. Every other service must be stopped first.
desc.fixMessageInconsistencies: Use when a message is listed but cannot be read, or the reverse. Repairs the message tables.
desc.recomputeMailboxCounters: Use when the unread or total counts of mailboxes look wrong. Recounts every mailbox.
desc.recomputeMailboxQuota: Use when a user's quota usage looks wrong. Recounts every user's usage.
desc.fixMappingDenormalization: Use when an alias or forward is ignored although it is listed. Rewrites the mapping lookup tables.
desc.repositionSystemRights: Use when team mailbox folders can no longer be managed. Gives the system users back their full rights on every folder.
desc.cleanupJmapUploads: Deletes expired JMAP uploads: attachments sent to the server but never used in a mail.
desc.blobGarbageCollection: Frees storage held by blobs no message references any more. Heavy on object storage.
desc.purgeDeletedMessages: Permanently deletes the messages of the Deleted Messages Vault whose retention period is over.
desc.cleanupTrashAll: Permanently deletes old messages from every user's Trash.
desc.cleanupSpamAll: Permanently deletes old messages from every user's Spam.
desc.cleaningUpOldTasks: Forgets the finished tasks older than the given number of days, to keep the task list short.
desc.reloadCertificates: Use after renewing the TLS certificates: reloads them without restarting the server.
desc.importLdapUsers: Registers on the calendar server the LDAP users that are not registered yet.
desc.addMissingFields: Fills in the fields missing from registered users, such as their first or last name.
desc.domainMemberSync: Updates the "Domain members" address book of every domain from LDAP.
desc.republishCommonContacts: Use when domain or user contacts are missing for other users. Publishes them again.
desc.calendarEventReindex: Use when events are missing from calendar searches. Rebuilds the event search index.
desc.alarmRescheduling: Use when event reminders are not sent. Schedules the alarms of every event again.
desc.calendarEventArchival: Moves the events matching the criteria into an "Archival" calendar of each user.
desc.clearDomainMembersContacts: Empties the "Domain members" address book of every domain. Run a synchronization to fill it again.
desc.twakeSpacePurge: Deletes the team mailboxes of the spaces deleted for longer than the retention set in space.properties, freeing their addresses. TMail no longer runs it on its own: schedule it with an external cron, or run it here.
desc.twakeSpaceReindex: Use after binding team mailboxes outside of the extension (e.g. a migration from the Twake Mail side service), or if the index mailbox was lost. Scans every team mailbox.

rateLimits.invalidDesc: Enter a positive integer, -1 for unlimited, or leave empty for the default limit.

consequence.deleteUserData: All mailboxes, messages, identities, labels, vacation and settings of {{user}} are permanently deleted. The account itself is kept. This cannot be undone.
consequence.deleteMailboxes: Every mailbox of {{user}} and all the messages they contain are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
consequence.deleteMailbox: "{{mailbox}}", its sub-folders and all their messages are permanently deleted.
consequence.clearMailbox: All messages of "{{mailbox}}" are permanently deleted; the folder is kept.
consequence.clearRepository: The {{count}} mails stored in {{path}} are permanently deleted and can no longer be reprocessed.
consequence.clearGroup: The dead-lettered events are deleted without being redelivered: what they would have updated stays out of date.
consequence.deleteCalendarUserData: Every calendar, event, address book, contact and booking link of this user will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
consequence.clearDomainMembersContacts: The "Domain members" address book of every domain, except the skipped ones, is emptied. This cannot be undone.
consequence.fixMailboxInconsistencies: Stop every other Twake Mail service before running this task.
consequence.blobGarbageCollection: Stored blobs that no message references any more are permanently deleted from the object storage. This cannot be undone.
consequence.purgeDeletedMessages: The messages of the Deleted Messages Vault whose retention period is over are permanently deleted and can no longer be restored.
consequence.twakeSpacePurge: The team mailboxes of the spaces deleted for longer than the retention of space.properties, and all their mail, are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
